expires_today.title: World Builders: Americana
expires_today.description: Create a slice of American life
expires_today.long_description:
Celebrate the 250th birthday of the United States by adding a massive collection of A1 game assets to your personal library! Pay what you want for the World Builders: Americana Bundle and drop your players into a sinisterly simple suburban hellscape or a haunting hospital perfect for high-stakes sieges. Unlock 75+ themed asset packs like Meridian 1988: Captain Jimmy's Seafood - Modular Environment (VOL 6) and Meridian 1988: Genie Service Station - Modular Environment (VOL 16), and add detailed retro realism to your next project! As always, a portion of your purchase helps support the Forest School Foundation.

Keys Expire. Please redeem before December 21, 2027.

expires_today.title: Premium Sci-Fi Design Training Bundle
expires_today.description: Master modern staples of game development
expires_today.long_description:
Curious about game design? Then you need the Premium Sci-Fi Design Training Bundle by Learn Squared! Go from game lover to developer when you study under the best—learn how to bring your artistic side into the digital world with Concepting in ZBrush, jump into your own vessel of the stars with Starship Design, create original protagonists with Futuristic Character Design, and more. Get the expert instruction and knowledge you seek, and help support Girls Who Code with your purchase!

Keys Expire. Please redeem before July 7th, 2027.

expires_today.title: Creature and Character Creation Bundle
expires_today.long_description:
Bring monstrosities, blood-dripping creatures, and ghastly ghouls to life with a curated bundle of assets designed to get your players’ hearts pumping! Pay what you want for hundreds of specialized asset packs that work seamlessly with your preferred creation platforms, such as VDM Blender and ZBrush, including Faceit: Facial Expressions and Performance Capture and Base Mesh Mega Pack 3D Models - Human, Anime & Cartoon Animals. Plus, your purchase includes 44 ears, 44 teeth, 44 noses, and much, much more. Create amazing monsters before it’s too late, and help support Save the Children with your purchase!

Keys expire. Please redeem your keys before October 31, 2026.

expires_tomorrow.title: Going Rogue: A Lite Heavy Bundle
expires_tomorrow.long_description:
Dive into adventure and mystery with this bundle of roguelike and roguelite action games! Make a deal with a demon to exact revenge on your murderer in Brutal Orchestra! Survive a decaying spaceship full of killer monsters in the procedurally generated deep space purgatory of Moros Protocol! Take on the adventures and challenges of these roguelikes and more in this bundle, and support Team Rubicon with your purchase at the price of your choice!

Keys expire. Please redeem Moros Protocol before January 15th, 2027 and remaining titles before July 15th, 2027.

expires_tomorrow.title: And the Winner Is: Award Winning Fantasy, Science Fiction, & Horror from Tachyon
expires_tomorrow.long_description: Here at Humble, we only want to give you the best of the best, and for our more discerning readers we’ve crafted a bundle of sci-fi, fantasy, and horror ebooks from Tachyon that aren’t just great reads, but award-winning modern classics! Dive into tales of technology and terror from genre-blending master Peter Watts in his short story collection Beyond the Rift! Wartime history and B-movie schlock combine in James Morrow’s World War II kaiju extravaganza Shambling Towards Hiroshima! An utterly unique voice takes on worlds beyond our own in Ellen Klages’ haunting short story collection Portable Childhoods! There is so much more to discover in this collection of fiction from some of today’s most daring authors, so grab these books while you can at the price of your choice, and support Doctors Without Borders with your purchase!

expires_tomorrow.title: Upload VR Summer 2026
expires_tomorrow.long_description:
Freshen up your VR collection with an epic bundle of titles perfect for any platform. Jump into the cockpit of a wide variety of aircraft in VTOL VR, a near-futuristic combat flight game built to get your heart pumping! Brave Metro Awakening, a story-driven VR adventure that blends exploration and FPS gameplay to deliver a completely immersive experience. Or get a lil’ strange with Among Us 3D, a new twist on the original game’s formula that drops you into chaos! Step out of reality and into a world of savings—plus, your purchase helps support Kiss the Ground!

Keys expire. Please redeem before July 8th, 2027.

expires_tomorrow.title: Unreal Environment Bundle
expires_tomorrow.long_description: Craft beautiful vistas in a fraction of the time it normally takes your team with the all-new Unreal Environment Bundle. Set the scene for epic boss battles, cozy sims, and more with crisp, easy-to-use preset Environmental Packs like Coast & Dunes, Mountain, Forest, Meadow, and more. Add layers of detailed depth to any scenery or scenario with asset sets that mesh seamlessly with each other. Unlock everything you need from the ground up with these elite environmental tools from NatureManufacture, and help support the Starlight Children's Foundation with your purchase!
